en.tagline: Plan and prepare a Product Hunt launch
en.summary: This skill helps you plan a Product Hunt launch. It covers listing specs, gallery images, taglines, launch timing, maker comments, and launch day steps. It also uses the belt CLI to generate gallery images and search for competitor launches.
problem: A Product Hunt launch has many small details. Tagline length, gallery order, posting time, and the maker comment all affect how a product appears on launch day. Without a plan, these are easy to miss.
With this skill, the launch follows a set of listing specs and a timeline. Gallery images are generated with belt app run. Similar launches are researched before launch day.
fit: Preparing a SaaS or developer tool for a Product Hunt launch
Writing a tagline and checking it against the 60 character limit
Planning gallery images and launch day timing
unfit: Products that are not launching on Product Hunt
Launches that depend on asking people for upvotes, which the skill advises against
steps: Check the listing specs: tagline up to 60 characters, the first 260 description characters, up to 8 gallery images, and up to 3 topics.
Generate gallery images with `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora`.
Research similar launches with `belt app run tavily/search-assistant` and `belt app run exa/search`.
Pick a launch day on Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday, with the product going live at 12:01 AM PT.
Post the maker comment within 5 minutes of going live, then reply to every comment through the day.
After launch, reply to remaining comments, publish a lessons learned post in week 1, and follow up with interested users in week 2.

zh.tagline: 规划并准备 Product Hunt 产品发布
zh.summary: 本技能帮助你规划 Product Hunt 产品发布。内容包括列表规格、画廊图片、标语、发布时间、Maker 评论和发布当天的流程。它还能通过 belt CLI 生成画廊图片，并搜索竞品的发布情况。
problem: Product Hunt 发布涉及许多细节。标语长度、画廊顺序、发布时间和 Maker 评论，都会影响产品在发布当天的展示效果。没有计划时，这些很容易被忽略。
使用本技能后，发布会按照一组列表规格和时间表进行。画廊图片通过 belt app run 生成，发布前还能调研类似产品的发布情况。
fit: 为 SaaS 或开发者工具准备 Product Hunt 发布
撰写标语并检查是否符合 60 字符限制
规划画廊图片和发布当天的时间安排
unfit: 不在 Product Hunt 上发布的产品
依赖请人点赞来推动发布的做法，本技能不建议这样做
steps: 检查列表规格：标语不超过 60 字符，描述前 260 字符会在预览中显示，最多 8 张画廊图片，最多 3 个话题。
使用 `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora` 生成画廊图片。
使用 `belt app run tavily/search-assistant` 和 `belt app run exa/search` 调研类似产品的发布情况。
选择周二、周三或周四发布，产品于太平洋时间 12:01 AM 上线。
上线后 5 分钟内发布 Maker 评论，并在当天回复每一条评论。
发布后，回复剩余评论；第一周发布复盘文章，第二周跟进感兴趣的用户。
